A Step Above Commercial Media

Sponsoring public media has benefits that typical commercial outlets
cannot touch. Through the decades, GBH has earned the trust of its
audience, and this relationship presents a unique opportunity for corporate
sponsors.

A Trusted Brand

GBH is a trusted source of content that promotes educational equity, delivers unbiased news, and inspires everyone to engage with the world around them. Bostonians agree, GBH is the most trusted local media.

83%
98% of GBH 89.7 listeners agree that GBH provides information that I trust.
81%
96% of GBH TV viewers agree GBH TV is an asset to the local community.

Public Media Halo Effect

GBH sponsors benefit from the public media halo effect: our audiences trust us and – in turn – our sponsors. You can’t get that with advertising on commercial broadcasts.

60%
75% of the GBH audience prefers to purchase a product or service from a company that sponsors GBH.

Uncluttered Environment

Commercial radio and television have three to five times more promo minutes per hour. Our unique clutter-free environment means sponsor messages stand out.
